caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a wooden cradle, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The cradle is brown in color, with wood grain texture visible throughout. It has curved rockers at the bottom and vertically oriented ends, each featuring a rounded top with a small finial at both corners and a small, heart-shaped cut-out near the center. The sides of the cradle are straight and join the two end pieces. The structure is shown in a three-quarters view, allowing both a frontal and a side perspective of the cradle. There are no other objects or prominent features in the drawing apart from the cradle, and some handwritten text is visible on the lower border and to the right of the cradle.
title: Pioneer Baby's Cradle
